Nour Time helps your child enjoy screen time in a healthy amount. You choose the apps and the time. When the time runs out, Nour kindly lets your child know it\'s time for something else.

What Nour Time needs, and why

Nour Time is a parental control app. To limit your child\'s time on the apps you choose, it needs the permissions below. Nour Time never reads what\'s on the screen and has no ads or tracking. Nothing leaves this phone unless you connect your own phone as a parent. Then only the time left, the minutes used on each app, the list of apps and Nour Time\'s settings are shared with your Google account.
You\'ll grant each permission yourself, one at a time, and you can turn any of them off later from the phone\'s settings.
4 digits. You\'ll use it to unlock the device and open Nour Time\'s settings. Keep it away from your child.

Sees which apps are on screen (including picture-in-picture and split screen), so the timer only runs while a selected app is in use. It never reads what\'s on the screen.

Nour Time uses the Accessibility service only to know which apps are on the screen, including small picture-in-picture windows and split screen. For each window it reads just the name of the app that owns it. It never reads the text, pictures or anything else shown in an app, and never what your child types. That way the timer runs only while a selected app is in use, and the \"Time\'s up\" screen appears at the right moment. What it sees stays on this phone. If you connect your own phone, only the time left and the minutes used are shared with you.
In Settings, open \"Installed apps\" (or \"Downloaded apps\"), tap Nour Time, and turn it on.
On the Accessibility page, scroll down: Nour Time is listed there. Tap it and turn it on.
Is the switch greyed out? On Android 13 and newer: open App info, tap the ⋮ menu, choose \"Allow restricted settings\", then try again.
A backup way to detect the open app, and the source of your daily usage stats.

Nour Time uses usage access as a backup way to know which app is in the foreground, and to show you how long each app was used today. This stays on this phone unless you connect your own phone. Then the minutes used on each limited app are shared with you.
Find Nour Time in the list and turn on \"Permit usage access\".
Shows the friendly \"Time\'s up\" screen on top of the selected apps.
When the time runs out, Nour Time shows a friendly \"Time\'s up\" screen on top of the selected apps. Android needs this permission to allow that.
Turn on \"Allow display over other apps\" for Nour Time.
This phone opens the list of all apps. Search for Nour Time (or scroll to it), tap it and turn on \"Allow display over other apps\".
Locks the screen when time is up and protects Nour Time from being removed.
Device admin lets Nour Time lock the screen when the time is up, and stops the app from being uninstalled without your PIN. Nour Time can\'t read or erase your data with it.
Locks the screen when your child\'s time is up, and protects Nour Time from being removed without the parent PIN.
Android shows a small notification while Nour Time runs in the background.
Android requires a small, silent notification while Nour Time protects the device in the background. Nour Time never sends ads or promotional notifications.
Keeps the timer running reliably in the background.
Some phones put background apps to sleep to save battery. Allowing Nour Time to run without restrictions keeps the timer accurate. Nour Time uses very little battery.
%1$s phones can stop apps from starting on their own. Allow Nour Time to autostart so protection comes back after the phone restarts.
In the screen that opens, turn on Nour Time. If it doesn\'t open, look for \"Autostart\" or \"App launch\" in the phone\'s settings.
In the screen that opens, turn on Autostart for Nour Time. Then open Settings → Apps → Nour Time → Battery saver and choose \"No restrictions\".
In the screen that opens, turn on Nour Time. On newer phones this is usually in App info → Battery usage: turn on \"Allow auto launch\" and \"Allow background activity\".
In the screen that opens, turn on Nour Time. Then check Settings → Battery → Background power consumption and allow Nour Time.
In \"App launch\", find Nour Time, switch it to \"Manage manually\" and turn on all three switches (auto-launch, secondary launch, run in background).
In the screen that opens, turn on Nour Time. Then in App info → Battery, allow background activity (\"Don\'t optimize\").
Samsung phones put apps they think are unused to sleep. Keep Nour Time awake so protection keeps running.
In Battery → Background usage limits, make sure Nour Time isn\'t in \"Sleeping apps\" or \"Deep sleeping apps\", and add it to \"Never sleeping apps\".
